dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, single white horizontal band across the greater coverts; sharp boundary against dark feather centers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, sharp pale bluish-white edges along the outer webs of the folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, high-contrast white oval patch located on the central posterior nape.
